**Requisition Summary**
 This position is located at PACCAR’s global headquarters in downtown Bellevue, Washington, and provides an exciting opportunity to support the strategic direction of PACCAR by developing and applying analytical models that identify and quantify risk in PACCAR’s global portfolio of financial products.
   

  

 As an Associate Data Scientist within the Portfolio Risk and Analysis Group, you will provide analytically sound risk models and data\-driven insights that inform credit decisions by PACCAR’s finance organizations in Europe, North America, Latin America, and Australia, as well as senior management and company executives. Your work will directly support truck sales by helping dealers and customers acquire Kenworth, Peterbilt, and DAF trucks while ensuring decisions are grounded in the performance, trends, and risk characteristics of a global finance portfolio exceeding $20\.0 billion. You will utilize your education and work experience to drive new projects and improvements to existing processes. Company executives and analytic partners will rely on you for timely, trustworthy, and relevant business insights gained through best practices in data science and advanced analytic techniques.
